title: CISA Catalog of Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (curated sample)
_note: Curated 16-record subset of the real CISA KEV catalog, using its exact schema, for offline tests and the demo. The live pipeline fetches the full catalog (~1790 records) at runtime from https://www.cisa.gov/sites/default/files/feeds/known_exploited_vulnerabilities.json

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache Log4j2 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apache Log4j2 contains a vulnerability where JNDI features do not protect against attacker-controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints, allowing remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (PrintNightmare)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (ProxyLogon)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft Exchange Server contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows an attacker to send arbitrary HTTP requests and authenticate as the Exchange server.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Progress MOVEit Transfer SQL Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Progress MOVEit Transfer contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to the database.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway Buffer Overflow Vulnerability (Citrix Bleed)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for sensitive information disclosure when configured as a Gateway or AAA virtual server.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS SSL VPN Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiOS contains a path traversal vulnerability in the SSL VPN web portal that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to download system files via crafted HTTP requests.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure and Policy Secure Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure and Policy Secure contain an authentication bypass vulnerability in the web component that allows an attacker to access restricted resources.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure and Policy Secure Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure and Policy Secure contain a command injection vulnerability that allows an authenticated administrator to send crafted requests and execute arbitrary commands.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Center Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Center contain an OGNL injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco IOS XE Web UI Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Cisco IOS XE Web UI contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to create an account with privilege level 15 access.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Spring Framework JDK 9+ Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (Spring4Shell)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Spring Framework contains a vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution when deployed on Apache Tomcat as a WAR under specific conditions.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: VMware vCenter Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: VMware vCenter Server contains a remote code execution vulnerability in a vSphere Client plugin that allows an attacker with network access to port 443 to execute commands.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy SSL-VPN Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy SSL-VPN contain a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via crafted requests.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a command injection vulnerability in the GlobalProtect feature that allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache Roller Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apache Roller contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the XML-RPC endpoint.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Expressway Series Use of Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Cisco Expressway Series contains a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access the system.
